any_of: MetLife Accident Insurance can complement existing medical coverage

extraction_notes:
This is a MetLife "Employee Benefits Proposal" document that bundles multiple voluntary products (this instance only contained Accident, but other instances may include Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, etc. - only extract the Accident product per instructions). Layout details for the Accident product:

- Cover page gives group name (employer), proposal date, and Proposed Customer Effective Date (use as effective_date).
- "Proposal Assumptions" table (page 2-3) gives Situs State, SIC code, Number of Eligible Employees, Employee Eligibility rules, Takeover provisions, Contributions (100% Employee Paid = voluntary), and Commissions - these are informational, not per-plan benefit data.
- "Plan Design" table (page 4) describes Coverage Type (24hr on/off job), Benefit Amount/Underwriting (Guaranteed Issue, single plan of coverage - meaning there is typically only ONE plan/rate tier offered, not multiple plan options), Pre-existing Condition Limitation, Portability provision.
- "Rate Information" table gives Rate Structure (Composite Rates - i.e., rates do NOT vary by age/state, just by tier), Rate Guarantee period, Participation Requirements.
- "Proposed Rates Plan" table (page 5) is the actual rate grid: rows are enrollment tiers (Employee Only, Employee + Spouse, Employee + Children, Employee + Spouse/Children) with a single "Monthly" column - map these directly to employee_only/employee_spouse/employee_children/family. There is only ONE plan design in this document (single composite-rated plan), so only one plan entry is needed under "plans" array.
- "Covered Benefits" table (pages 6-9) is the detailed benefit schedule, organized by Category > Subcategory > Benefit line item > flat dollar amount (or % for chip fracture/partial dislocation/skin graft). Categories seen: Accidental Injury Benefits (Fracture Closed/Open, Dislocation Closed/Open, Burn, Concussion, Coma, Laceration), Accident-Medical Treatment and Services Benefits (Ambulance, Emergency Care, Non-Emergency Initial Care, Medical Testing, Physician Follow-Up, Therapy Services, Prosthetic Device, Medical Appliance + limit, Blood/Plasma/Platelets, Surgery Benefit, Exploratory Surgery, Other Outpatient Surgery), Accident-Hospital Benefits (Admission, Confinement incl. ICU, Rehab), Other Benefits Category (Health Screening Benefit). Extract every line item as its own benefit key with the flat dollar (or %) amount as the value - there is no deductible/OOP/coinsurance structure since this is a fixed-indemnity accident product (deductible_individual/family, oop_max fields, out_of_network should be omitted/left blank).
- No age-banded rates, no per-state rate variation shown (composite rate applies across the group per the situs state, with note that final rates may vary due to rounding).
- Pages 11-16 contain lengthy state-by-state exclusion/limitation variation language - ignore for extraction, not benefit amounts.
- Pages 17-19 are general disclaimers/compensation notices - ignore.
- Total plans in this document: 1 Accident plan (single composite rate plan with 4 rate tiers). If a future document shows multiple accident "plan options" (e.g., Low/High plan), expect multiple rate columns in the Proposed Rates table and a parallel "Plan" column with multiple values in the Covered Benefits table - extract each as a separate plan entry with its own benefits map.
